author: TheLastNail
text: Hi Gembel May I ask you how you draw these FLs? What are the clear rules? Please don't say to go look at mpedia article or something like that as I've studied both marketpedia and both If and Fxjogi (at FF) charts for more hours that I'm comfortable to admit but I still dont get it. I could post some of your charts with questions but I don't want to spam your thread. As I see it every time some minor or major high or low gets engulfed it creates new FL. So on every chart there is small billion of FLs and its difficult for me to understand which ones are important. Engulf of some indicate price wants go to next FL, engulf of some other seems to be FO, after engulf of some price retaraces through few of FLs(ignores them) before bouncing of one FL and going to the next. I'm always wondering when analyze yours of Fxjogis charts why you have choose that box as imporant and not even mark some other. People say draw them as you think but in order to read and predict price we need to have some solid scientific rules as If has taught us trading is science, with no subjectivity at all. I think this is vital to understand PA as everything revolves around FL, eng and PAZ. Can you please provide some clarification if possible?
